name: Lorwyn Eclipsed
notes: Five creature-type themes anchor the format; changelings connect them.
Build a dependable two-color base before considering a splash.
Check creature types as well as individual card strength.

archetypes.name: Merfolk
archetypes.detail: Convoke turns a developed board into mana.

archetypes.name: Goblins
archetypes.detail: Expendable creatures help absorb the cost of your payoffs.

archetypes.name: Kithkin
archetypes.detail: Team bonuses reward keeping several creatures in play.

archetypes.name: Elementals
archetypes.plan: Cast spells with mana value four or more.
archetypes.detail: Ramp helps reach the expensive spells that reward this deck.

archetypes.name: Elves
archetypes.detail: Self-mill supports creature recursion and graveyard payoffs.

mechanics.name: Changelings
mechanics.text: These creatures have every creature type.

mechanics.name: Blight
mechanics.text: Put the specified number of −1/−1 counters on one creature you control.

mechanics.name: Vivid
mechanics.text: Counts the colors among permanents you control, not the colors of mana you can produce.
